user.title: Main Configuration
user.description: Configure the core entities for your smart thermostat.

data.name: Thermostat Name
data.force_off_state: Force Actuator Off When Thermostat is Off

data_description.name: Name displayed for the climate entity in Home Assistant.
data_description.heater: Switch, valve, light, or number entity controlling heat (Required).
data_description.target_sensor: Temperature sensor measuring the room temperature (Required).
data_description.cooler: Optional actuator used when cooling mode is active.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional outdoor sensor used for Ke compensation.
data_description.invert_heater: Enable if the actuator must be turned off to heat (e.g., inverted relay).
data_description.ac_mode: Switch the main actuator to cooling mode instead of heating.
data_description.force_off_state: Ensures the actuator is physically turned off when HVAC mode is OFF.

data_description.min_temp: Leave blank to use Home Assistant default value.
data_description.max_temp: Leave blank to use Home Assistant default value.
data_description.boost_pid_off: Forces PID mode to OFF when Boost preset is enabled.

presets.title: Preset Temperatures
presets.description: Set temperatures for predefined modes (Leave blank to disable a preset).

pid.title: PID Controller
pid.description: Configure PID controller gains and timing parameters.

data_description.ke: Gain applied to the difference between target and outdoor temperature.
data_description.pwm: Full cycle time for pulse-width modulation regulation.
data_description.keep_alive: Periodically re-sends turn on/off commands to actuators.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Fine-tune cycle protection, output limits, and safety behavior.

data_description.sensor_stall: Timeout before falling back to safety level if sensor stops updating.
data_description.output_safety: Output percentage applied when sensor is stalled or unavailable.
